overall.verdict: This is a genuinely differentiated, high-trust fintech wallet that leads with a single absolute visual scale and an explicit on-chain vs hub-credit risk split — the strongest aspects are the sovereignty/risk screens and the proof receipts. It ships with a consistent dark system and excellent data legibility on core flows, but stumbles on small jargon ('lane', 'hub promise', 'send up to'), low-contrast decimal values, and a few cryptically dense helper blocks that weaken first-timer comprehension.
priority_fixes: 1. Raise the contrast of decimal/cent values and the small caption/legend text so exact balances and risk colors are legible at a glance (01-home, 06-account).
2. Add a persistent one-line glossary for the color system (collateral / at risk / you owe / credit room) on every screen that draws a multi-segment bar, not just the account view.
3. Replace jargon labels with plain language: 'Hub promise' → 'Hub credit (at risk)', 'lane' → 'route/token', 'send up to' → 'you can send up to'.
4. Consolidate the risk breakdown into the home header so newest users see 'enforceable now vs hub promise' before any action (01-home, 11-manage).
5. Make the proof/evidence surfaces uniform and tappable — one consistent proof hash format and a deep link to the full proof on both receipt and activity-detail screens.
